notes.title: Midnight Blood Rush - Play the new demo!
notes.content:
We're proud to announce that the new [b]Midnight Blood Rush[/b] demo is finally here! It contains [b]many new features[/b] while retaining the design spirit of the previous demo. This demo is more in keeping with the final game we have in mind.

We hope you like it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633325/34af91cac83919942e8d7135127519a683bbcffd.gif[/img]

New features include:

[list]
[*] A brand new [b]upgrade system[/b], bringing a variety of [b]elemental damage[/b] and synergies!
[*] A more complex [b]combat system[/b], with the addition of a way to [b]stun [/b]and then bite enemies, adding [b]extra dynamism and survivability[/b], especially during boss battles.
[*] The addition of an equipped and interchangeable [b]main attack system[/b], and devastating [b]special abilities[/b]!
[*] A [b]complete visual overhaul[/b] of the scenery and interface, and the addition of more complex character animations.
[*] An [b]improved music mix[/b], and several new ones!
[*] The introduction of a [b]brand new mini-boss and boss[/b], who we hope will give you a hard time!
[*] And finally, a new [b]second chance[/b] mechanic, which will allow you to come back to life... If you're quick enough!
[/list]

We hope you enjoy the demo! New content will also be arriving in the coming months, and we'll be on the lookout for feedback and any bugs to fix as soon as possible!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44633325/c8bc27c4a3d847451f5c56d3e1f9bfbe625ebd6d.gif[/img]
